# VRDex

> VRChat-first identity, profiles, communities, events, and developer utilities.

Canonical documentation:

- [Developer overview](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/)
- [Public API](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/public-api)
- [API authentication](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/api-auth)
- [VRDex Time API](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/time-api)
- [API rate limits](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/api-rate-limits)
- [Partner agent skill](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/partner-agent-skill)
- [MCP read tools](https://docs.vrdex.net/docs/developers/vrdex-mcp-read-tools)
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://vrdex.net/api/v0/openapi.json)
- [OpenAPI YAML](https://vrdex.net/api/v0/openapi.yaml)

Use the API or MCP for structured data. Preserve provenance and do not treat
unclaimed, community-submitted, imported, or AI-extracted data as
owner-confirmed.
